title: SIDESTORY: THE RIDES TO LAKE SILBERNEHERZE OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: THE RIDES TO LAKE SILBERNEHERZE OPEN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: The Rides to Lake Silberneherze event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
- Phase 1 Platform No. 3
- Phase 2 Express Train
[Tourists' To-Do List]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Tourists' To-Do List] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARD: [★★★★★: Harold], Snowcap Post Office Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Burdenbeast Blind Box, etc.
[Onboard Services]

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Burdenbeast Blind Box by clearing event stages and completing [Tourists' To-Do List] missions. Burdenbeast Blind Box can be used to redeem items from [Onboard Services].
REWARD: Harold's token, Snowcap Post Office Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
- During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – THE SOJOURNER
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [The Sojourner], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting
★★★★★★: Degenbrecher
★★★★★: Leto / Kafka

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game
★★★★★★: Degenbrecher
★★★★★: Leto
★★★★★: Harold
Note:
Operator Harold is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event The Rides to Lake Silberneherze, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
Degenbrecher and Leto will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after July 5, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
Degenbrecher, Leto and Harold will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
04 ICEFIELD MESSENGER COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Icefield Messenger Collection - Occasionally Flushed for Penance
Icefield Messenger Collection - Dance for Tsukinogi
Icefield Messenger Collection - Gratitude Gift for Qanipalaat
05 ICEFIELD MESSENGER COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Icefield Messenger Collection - Hohenlohe Chillysand for Carnelian
Icefield Messenger Collection - Hope Cruise for Leonhardt
Icefield Messenger Collection - Cardboard Fairy for Kafka
06 NEW FURNITURE SET SNOWCAP POST OFFICE
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, Snowcap Post Office will be available.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
The Rides to Lake Silberneherze event rewards and redeem in Onboard Services, Tourists' To-Do List (Pieces), Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
07 NEW LUCKY DROP FURNITURE SET RHODES ISLAND LAUNDRY
UPDATE TIME: June 21, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
LUCKY DROP: Themed furniture - Rhodes Island Laundry
HOW TO OBTAIN： Main Theme stages (excluding Challenge Mode and Tutorial) Lucky Drop, Supplies stage Lucky Drop.

DETAILS： New "Rhodes Island Laundry" themed furniture will replace the existing Lucky Drop "Detective's Study" themed furniture. After replacement, the "Detective's Study" themed furniture will be available for purchase in the Furniture Store.
"Detective's Study" sales start at: June 21, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
08 CHIP PACK AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
GUARD CHIP PACK
CONTENTS: Guard Dualchip *4, Guard Chip *5, Skill Summary - 3 *45, Skill Summary - 2 *25, Skill Summary - 1 *10
OTHERS:
Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar regular update
Permanently Available
'To Be Continued'
Start at: July 4, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)
Please stay tuned for more information!
